title: Beverage Element of a Contracted Event Value
content:
The bar element standing in a Private Event & Banquet Services contracted value follows the room set-up the confirmed guarantee entry is built to and the count standing on the booking, that count being the higher of the count a confirmed guarantee entry guarantees and the working count the booking was taken at.

## The rule

1. Where the room stands set for a reception and the count standing on the booking reaches the smallest guest count printed against the package, the bar minimum printed against the package stands in the contracted value in full, a reception being drinks-led.
2. Where the room stands set for seated rounds and the count standing on the booking reaches the smallest guest count printed against the package, the seated share of that bar minimum stands in the contracted value, wine being taken at the table rather than at a full bar. That seated share is 50 per cent of the bar minimum, that is one half of it.
3. Where the room stands set otherwise, or the count standing on the booking does not reach the smallest guest count printed against the package, no bar element stands in the contracted value.

## What each package puts into the two cases

| Package | Bar minimum, USD | Smallest guest count | Reception | Seated rounds |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 0 | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 750 | 25 | 750 | 375 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 1800 | 60 | 1800 | 900 |
| Gala Reception Package | 4500 | 150 | 4500 | 2250 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 9500 | 200 | 9500 | 4750 |

## Basis questions

*On a count exactly at the smallest guest count.* A count standing at the smallest guest count printed against the package reaches it, and the bar element stands.

*On a room set for theater, classroom or boardroom.* No bar element stands in the contracted value on those set-ups, whatever the count standing on the booking, and none stands where no confirmed guarantee entry names a set-up.
